reasoning: On the season so far the Celtics are the stronger team; with home court the Celtics start about 10 points better, in a game of about 216 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 4 points towards the Magic.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Celtics win 67 times in 100, by about 6; most games like this end between 190 and 239 total points.
